name: Rula Diya Na Bechaari Ko
visual_description: Aman Verma consoles his crying wife while casting an accusing look at his mother Hema Malini from the film Baghban.
usage_context: Used sarcastically to call someone out for unnecessarily hurting, upsetting, or offending someone, or making a trivial issue dramatic.

example.top_text: When you show your mom her own screen time report

text_areas.description: Setup or action causing the emotional distress/drama
